body.def: For nonempty closed \(\mathcal D\subseteq[0,1]\), let \(\bar\delta=\max\mathcal D\) and define \(\Theta_I^{\mathcal D}(b,q,\omega)=\Theta_{I,\bar\delta}(b,q,\omega)\).
body.role: sensitivity-range sharp identified set, equal to the maximal admissible sensitivity fiber
